The '''Jedi Ambassador''', or '''Jedi Advisor''',<ref name="FaD">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|'''Star Wars: Force and Destiny''' Core Rulebook]]</ref> was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who had followed the teachings of the [[Jedi Consular]]s. A specialization undertaken by a few, a Jedi Ambassador served as representatives to the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]].

==Overview==
Unlike the [[Jedi Diplomat]], Jedi Ambassadors rarely were involved in the making of treaties or signing of documents. Their job was to be the public face of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], traveling as representatives to newly discovered worlds or to government palaces whose people wished to lobby for membership in the Republic. Serving directly under the [[Council of Reconciliation/Legends|Council of Reconciliation]], the Ambassadors worked alongside the [[Republic Diplomatic Corps/Legends|Republic Diplomatic Corps]], and were sent in ahead of other ships to ensure the that a planet's military would not designate them a threat.<ref name="TJP" />

Occasionally, certain Jedi Ambassadors would be assigned as a personal adviser to a [[Senator/Legends|senator]]. Requests for an appointed adviser could come from a senator, and would be directed to the Reconciliation Council and the [[Council of Reassignment/Legends|Reassignment Council]] for review. Many [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellors]] requested a personal adviser, often someone they were close with or had past experiences with.<ref name="TJP" /> Sometimes, the Jedi Council may opt to assign a Jedi to the Supreme Chancellor rather than waiting to be approached. Such was the case at the conclusion of the [[New Sith Wars]] when Chancellor [[Tarsus Valorum/Legends|Tarsus Valorum]] was given a newly promoted Jedi Knight [[Johun Othone]] by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Valenthyne Farfalla]] to assist him in matters until his term ended. In actuality, this was a move to show the Jedi Council's support for the recovery process of the Republic rather than to have a voice of the Council in the Senate.<ref name="RoT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref> Centuries earlier, Master [[Memit Nadill]] had served as adviser to [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Teta/Legends|Teta]] during the [[Unification Wars (Koros)/Legends|Unification Wars (Koros)]].<ref name="TotJ">''[[Star Wars: Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith]]''</ref> [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] member Master [[Adi Gallia/Legends|Adi Gallia]] had a very close professional relationship with Chancellor [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] as of [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]]. Their relationship was opportunistic in that the High Council received an influx of information from the [[Office of the Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Office of the Supreme Chancellor]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

Masters [[Jorus C'baoth]],<ref name="Heir to the Empire">''[[Heir to the Empire]]''</ref> [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]], [[Kit Fisto/Legends|Kit Fisto]],<ref name="ImageAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/09/imageattack20030923.html|series=Image Attack|text=Jedi Advisors}}</ref> [[Plo Koon/Legends|Plo Koon]],<ref name="Forceful Advisors">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/12/imageattack20031202.html|series=Image Attack|text=Forceful Advisors}}</ref> and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]s<ref name="ROTS" /><ref name="Stass db">{{DB|character|stassallie|Allie, Stass}}</ref> [[Stass Allie/Legends|Stass Allie]],<ref name="Forceful Advisors" /> [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] all served as advisers to Palpatine. C'baoth helped Palpatine while he was a senator, and Skywalker was appointed as war-time adviser during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. The latter relationship grew as Palpatine had planned, as he was actually the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] Darth Sidious.<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Ylenic It'kla]] was the personal adviser to [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] between [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] until his [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|death]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] in [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] (albeit unofficially due to the Reassignment Council having been destroyed during the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]]).<ref name="I,J">''[[I, Jedi]]''</ref>
